detail.longDescription: Hi everyone, I have been working on this for some time. It still has some bugs but I find it quite playable. The lack of remastered Red Alert 2 had been bothering me, that and other remakes I've seen done by Opus motivated me to start this project. This is clean-room in the sense that the speccer agent never communicated with the implementer and there was a scrubber in the middle. Please let me know what you think.
